newsitem.title: UK: UK's Transco to issue tender on Friday to sell gas.
newsitem.headline: UK's Transco to issue tender on Friday to sell gas.

text.p: Transco, the pipeline, transport and storage arm of BG plc, is due to announce a tender on Friday to sell stored gas into the U.K. market.
"Transco will be offering for sale gas-in-store not expected to be required for operating margins or top up purposes for the 1997/1998 storage year," Transco told gas shippers this week.
"The tender will be issued on Friday June 13 with a closing date of 20 June," Transco said in the notice, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters. The tender will be awarded on June 23.

The gas will be made available under a phased disposal programme from July through to September this year at Partington, in northwest England, and at the Rough storage facility off northeastern England.

The notice did not specify the quantities of gas that would be sold but the company said last month it was going to issue a tender in June to sell 2.4 terawatt-hours (82 million therms) of gas in a phased disposal over the summer.
Transco stores gas to meet extra demand in case of incidents such as pipeline breaks or offshore failures, and it calls this 'Operating Margins' gas.
'Top Up' gas is held to meet extreme demand represented by the 1-in-20 peak day (a cold day of such severity that it might occur once every twenty years,) or the 1-in-50 peak winter.
